summary: On the self-hosted ci boxes, the pull-request and merge-group test shards run with TMPDIR in a per-runner directory on /dev/shm (tmpfs, mounted exec, at least 20 GiB free), as the GitHub-runner shards do since the previous change. The tests about durability or disk cost keep RUNNER_TEMP/t through CI_TEST_DISK_TMPDIR. The directory is removed on exit, failure and cancel, and by the runner's next tests job after a kill; a warning fires if a shard uses more than 4 GiB of it. Daily shards and the mail-redelivery canaries are unchanged.

replay.detail: Test environment only; no claim, replay or projection change.

rules.detail: No rule, permission or trust change.

compatibility.detail: No wire, CLI or client change.

downtime.detail: Nothing runs differently on installed machines.

recovery.detail: Revert the commit to run the ci-box test shards with TMPDIR on RUNNER_TEMP/t again.
